H01.description: Imports getTransitionRoot needed by the fragment-transition removal fix.

H07.description: Removing a Fragment vnode that carries a transition bypasses the leave transition and afterLeave (removed immediately via removeFragment, or via a dev-only DEV_ROOT_FRAGMENT path), so production and dev behave differently and out-in transitions are not run/released.

H08.description: performRemove only removes the single el node, so it cannot correctly remove a fragment's full DOM range after its leave transition.

H09.description: The leave-transition check tests the vnode's own ELEMENT shape flag, so a fragment whose transition root is an element never gets its leave transition.

H10.description: leave/delayLeave are invoked on vnode.el rather than the transition root element, which is wrong for fragment vnodes whose el is the fragment start anchor.
